messages:
Maria Chen: Quick thread to finalize outbound comms for last night's onboarding webhook delay. Need: short customer note, AE/CSM exec summary, and a frontline script.

Javed Patel: How many customers impacted and severity?

Maria Chen: Eight trial tenants impacted between 02:14-02:45 UTC. Three are high-touch onboarding flows. Root cause: transient routing bug in auth proxy. Patch + failover at 02:40 UTC.

Leo Ortiz: Recommend offering 7 free trial days + 30-min enablement for high-touch customers; re-ingest if needed.

Priya Singh: Keep email non-technical: what happened, what we did, what we're doing for them, timeline.

Maria Chen: Draft customer note:

Hi <CustomerName>,

We experienced a brief onboarding delivery delay affecting your trial between 02:14-02:45 UTC. The issue has been patched and deliveries are routing normally.

What we did: applied a patch, failed over impacted queues, and rechecked/requeued any missed items.
What we're doing for you: we9re offering 7 free trial days and an optional 30-minute enablement session. We9ll confirm once verification is complete.

Apologies for the interruption. Reply to schedule the enablement session.

Thanks,
Redwood Inference CS Team

Javed Patel: Small wording tweak approved.

CS-Bot: Incident IR-2026-403 created, runbook linked (owner: infra-team).

Priya Singh: Frontline script:
"We9re aware of a delivery delay earlier today. The issue is patched and service is normal. Affected customers are being offered 7 free trial days and a 30-minute enablement call. If they ask for technical detail, escalate to the assigned CSM; do not escalate to Execs unless requested by the customer."

Leo Ortiz: I9ll outreach to the 3 high-touch accounts today EOD. @Maria please DM the contact list.

Maria Chen: Action items:
- Leo: outreach to 3 high-touch (TODAY EOD)
- Javed: bulk status email to other 5 trials (TOM AM)
- Priya: issue credits and tag Zendesk/SFDC
- Maria: prepare postmortem skeleton and share RCA draft

Priya Singh: After sending, tag cases with "onboard-delivery-delay" and set renewal-risk to "no-change" unless customer reports material impact.

Javed Patel: Will send draft in 30m.

CS-Bot: SLA credit workflow initiated for affected accounts.
